billing.title: Plan & billing
billing.description: Your BranchHarbor plan, trial, invoices and who pays for each location. Separate from customer payments.

planFor.connector: Keep your WordPress site · per location
planFor.network: HQ platform fee + per location · unlimited users

link.trial: Trial until {date}. Manage your plan, invoices and who pays each location.
link.manage: Manage your plan, invoices and who pays each location.

checkout.title: Start your {days}-day trial
checkout.intro: There is no free plan or free trial. Pay {fee} today, use everything for {days} days, and your plan then starts automatically unless you cancel.
checkout.countryHint: Your price, currency and tax follow your billing country. The card must be issued there, or add a business tax ID from it.
checkout.noTrial: A trial was already used for this business, card or email domain, so your plan starts today.
checkout.taxExclusive: Prices exclude tax. VAT or GST is added according to your billing country.
checkout.taxUs: Prices exclude sales tax, which is added where it applies.

terms.autoStart: Your {plan} plan starts automatically on {date} unless you cancel before then.
terms.reminders: We email you 3 days and 1 day before the trial ends.
terms.cancel: Cancel any time in Settings → Billing. No cancellation fee.
terms.export: Export all your data for free, at any time.
terms.lock: Your price is locked to your billing country and confirmed by your card.

checkout.taxIdHint: Only needed if your card is issued in another country, e.g. a VAT number.
checkout.agree: I agree to pay {fee} today for a {days}-day trial. On {date} my {plan} plan starts at {amount} plus tax, unless I cancel before then.
checkout.agreeNoTrial: I agree to pay {amount} plus tax from today, until I cancel.
checkout.agreeRequired: Tick the box to accept the trial terms.

card.title: Card
card.sandboxNote: No real charge: the API runs without Stripe keys. Choose the country the simulated card was issued in.
card.unavailable: Card entry is unavailable right now. Try again later.
card.failed: The card could not be confirmed. Try another card.

current.title: Your plan
current.daysLeft: {count, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}
current.trialCanceled: Your trial ends on {date}. Nothing more will be charged.
current.endsOn: Your plan ends on {date}. Nothing more will be charged.
current.pastDue: We couldn't take the last payment. Update your card to keep your plan.
current.cancelTrialBody: Your trial ends on {date} and nothing more is charged. No cancellation fee.
current.cancelPlanBody: Your plan stays active until {date}. No cancellation fee.

country.title: Billing country
country.body: Moving your business to another country? The new billing country needs a card issued there (or a business tax ID from it) and applies from your next billing period.

payers.title: Who pays each location
payers.intro: Your platform fee covers your first {count} locations. For each further location, choose who pays its {price} monthly fee: HQ, the franchisee or a split.
payers.ownerGroupHint: Applies to the group's locations unless a location has its own setting.
payers.totals: HQ pays {hq} · franchisees pay {franchisee} a month in total

fees.title: Other fees
fees.collection: Royalty and marketing-fund collection: {fee} per collection, capped at {cap} per location per month. Never a percentage of royalties.
fees.payments: Online customer payments: {percent} application fee plus the payment provider's own fee.
fees.terms: Monthly terms, annual billing with 2 months included, no cancellation fees, free data export.

banner.trial: Trial: {count, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}. Your {plan} plan starts on {date}.
banner.trialCanceled: Your trial ends on {date}. Nothing more will be charged.
banner.required: Start your {days}-day trial for {fee} to make changes and go live.
banner.canceled: Your plan has ended. Restart it to make changes; you can still export your data.
banner.pastDue: We couldn't take the last payment for your plan.

export.title: Export your data
export.body: Download a ZIP of CSV files with your business's core data: locations, people, customers, bookings, orders, invoices, leads and more. Free, at any time. We also email you the link, which works for 7 days.
export.requested: We're preparing your export. We'll email you when it's ready.

franchisee.title: Location fees
franchisee.description: The BranchHarbor fees headquarters passes on to you for your locations.
franchisee.intro: Headquarters passes on all or part of the fee for these locations. You pay from your own billing account, in the currency of your billing country.
franchisee.none: Headquarters pays the fees for your locations. You have nothing to pay.

change.title: Change plan
change.body: Switch plan or billing period at any time. Upgrades and downgrades are prorated for the rest of this period; there is no fee for changing.
change.trialNote: You are in your trial: nothing is charged now, and the new plan starts on {date}.
change.prorationNote: Prorated for the rest of this period; the new price applies from {date}.
change.creditNote: The unused part of your current plan is credited.
change.done: You are now on the {plan} plan.

cardChange.title: New card
cardChange.body: Use a card issued in {country}, your billing country, or add your business tax ID from there.
cardChange.done: Your new card is saved and will be used for the next charge.
